name: Douchebag: Ultimate Bro Pack
detailed_description:
We bring you back under the sun, where the girls are in bikinis, muscles are ripped and oiled up and the speakers are pumping bass. Your mission is simple; become a real douchebag by getting big muscles, increasing your swag and flirting with the ladies.

In this game, you play as different characters who have decided to change their lives by being more superficial.

You must make choices to improve their appearance while put aside their intelligence. You must accomplish certain tasks, such as working out or taking the bus to work. This allows you to have more muscles and more money to buy objects and clothes that enhance your body. You must talk to several other characters who are located in the trendiest places in town. Several mini-gameplays accompany your actions, such as doing your abs or building your pecs. You can even modify and improve your home to bring your flirts there. Some prestigious characters won't dare speak to you until you are irresistible.

Your future is in your hands. The goal remains to become perfect in the shortest possible time and to make your place between your new friends.

Have a lot of laughter in this funny world that caricatures our world.

• Enhance your style and grow your muscles!

• 5 games optimized in one!

• Play as 4 dudes and one chick!

• As they reach their full potentiel!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent depictions of sexualized characters wearing revealing swimwear and outfits, including exaggerated body proportions (e.g., large breasts, buttocks, and muscular physiques). The tone is comedic and over-the-top, satirizing superficial lifestyles. There is no nudity, sexual acts, or explicit sexual violence. Some suggestive dialogue and flirtatious interactions are present.
